source_evidence.enumeration: keyOrders includes exactly rows*columns indices, via row*columns+permutedColumn. Extra labels construct keyUis but no View is added and onChangeFocus has no address for omitted tail indices.

meaningful_minimal_fix_assessment.capacity_step: Use ceiling for the per-row column count so rows*columns>=itemCount; retain at most five columns and existing center-out ordering.
meaningful_minimal_fix_assessment.one_line_change_is_not_complete: Static row rendering also drops null cells without width placeholders, while focus hit testing uses fixed logical columns. When a partial row has missing columns at both ends, gravity is overwritten to START by the later missing cell and actual children shift left. Capacity-only invariants do not verify action reachability at visible centers.

concrete_newly_exposed_case.center_hit_result: Cell12 at actual column0 maps to missing14 and retains prior focus; cell10 at actualcolumn1 returns12; cell11 atactualcolumn2 returns10. This is a source/geometry deduction, not a claimed Android device execution.

meaningful_minimal_fix_assessment.cohesive_repair: A future single grid PR should both allocate enough slots and preserve logical-to-visible positions for the partial last row, e.g. fixed-width empty slot placeholders rather than dropping slots plus row gravity. Preserve non-empty cell actions and center-out ordering; do not bundle label/font/context changes.
meaningful_minimal_fix_assessment.empty_input: KeyView.showPopupKeyboard checks key.popup.isEmpty() and returns before sending ShowKeyboardAction; PopupDelegate itself does not check empty. Preserve that normal caller invariant or add only an explicit local nonempty precondition if required; do not invent unrelated empty-popup behavior.

existing_tests.android_coupling: Both helpers are currently instance methods on PopupContainerUi with Context/ThemeScope/Rect. Ordinary JVM tests cannot construct actual View UI without Android runtime; do not pretend a separately copied formula tests production.

pure_jvm_regression_design.production_extraction: If implemented later, extract only authoritative grid slot/index planning into a small Android-free production type consumed by PopupKeyboardUi rendering and focus selection. Pass bounded focusColumn from existing Rect-based calculation; no JNI, Robolectric or broad UI architecture changes required.
behavioral_properties: For item counts1..100 and every valid focus column, flatten occupied production layout slots; their multiset equals 0 until itemCount exactly, with no missing or duplicate input index. Assert each occupied slot resolves back to that same index through the production focus/index API.

For partial rows, rendered slot x positions must preserve the same logical column for hit selection; explicitly test central focus and holes on both sides. This catches the source-confirmed shift that a capacity-only formula test misses.
Golden order cases from the intended center/right/left policy: five columns focus2 gives [4,2,0,1,3]; focus0 gives [0,1,2,3,4]; focus4 gives [4,3,2,1,0]. Index0 remains initial focused item.
Counts at boundaries1,5,6,10,11,13,17,21,22,25 ensure rectangular capacity and complete reachability without deriving expected values by repeating the implementation ceil formula.

Do not newly test unchanged Rect fitting by copying its algorithm. Existing focus calculation can remain Android-dependent; separately bounded actual Popup UI tests should cover left/center/right triggers.
pure_jvm_regression_design.android_followup: A bounded actual PopupKeyboardUi probe with one-character ASCII labels avoids KeyAction/Rime reads, creates >1row13/21 items, traverses real child bounds and invokes public onChangeFocus/onTrigger at each nonempty cell center. Require original token exactly; explicitly disclose direct calls and unattached views. Root owns any later compile/device run.
